Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: The latest jobs report shows unemployment edging down to 7.2%, bringing a mixture of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is an alpine-inspired Swiss eatery offering cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Its rustic wooden interior, Swiss décor, city skyline views, and traditionally dressed staff create a welcoming atmosphere.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Your introduction and email make it clear whose site it is and how to contact you. Based on the content available, it feels quite minimal; adding a short bio, your interests, and examples of your work would help visitors get to know you better.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking gives your blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. Based on the content available, I’d love to see more detail—such as posts about favorite trails, trip stories, photos, and practical hiking tips—to make it more engaging and useful for readers.
